established_template.description: AI Current dark theme (matches the 'Template Newsletter' draft and current production issues). Every block wrapped in a node-section div with data-background-color #222222; text sections add data-color #FFFFFF; padding 20 on all sides. Cover image is a 16:9 imageBlock figure with 30px rounded corners (data-border-*-radius=30), width 100%, with alt text. Intro paragraph -> grouped story sections with h2 headings (e.g. Models & Infrastructure, Safety & Security, Funding & Deals, Policy & Compute) -> each story a lead sentence + neutral body + source link. Source links use Source: X for contrast on dark. Ads: one primary ad after the intro (top), two secondary ads at the bottom straddling the sign-off. Sign-off paragraph + full-width 'Share AI Current' button (href {{rp_referral_hub_url}}, custom bg #222222, text #FFFFFF) at the end.

ad_nodes.note: Embedding a list_ad_offers OFFER claims a NEW opportunity; the publication has an accept cap (hit at 67 accepted). Embedding an ALREADY-ACCEPTED opportunity id (from list_ad_opportunities status=accepted) does NOT count against the cap. Prefer accepted, unexpired opportunities when the cap is reached. Each opportunity id can only live in one post at a time.
